title: 0514 Final Claim Package
source_goal: Embodied memory maintenance under environmental change

thesis_alignment.original_problem: stale memory is harmful; move from passive replay/oracle verification to active closed-loop memory maintenance
thesis_alignment.current_supported_direction: controller-backed active memory maintenance under bounded sensing/navigation budget

evidence_chain.supported_claim: budgeted verification and visual-prior calibration reduce selected strict detector false negatives on a targeted protocol

one selected FloorPlan1/seed29/Apple row completes live spawn -> stepwise revisit -> GSAM stale verification -> detector-backed memory mutation -> stepwise task bridge -> PickupObject success without TeleportFull on measured paths
the guarded path only runs after detector-backed memory refresh; the high-threshold no-verify control skips verification, mutation, and task bridge
the same strict non-Teleport closed-loop sequence reproduces on a second selected FloorPlan1/Apple case and on the pre-registered two-case sweep
adaptive stepwise budgeting converts the same frozen six-case Apple/Pencil mixed challenge from 2/6 to 6/6 downstream PickupObject successes without TeleportFull on measured paths
under a frozen evidence-grounded local-artifact rule, there are zero eligible unseen holdout cases, so no new holdout run is performed

claim_matrix.claim: In controller-backed AI2-THOR live GSAM traces, MemoryGuard can perform bounded active memory maintenance through detector-backed verification/update and non-Teleport measured task execution on the frozen Apple/Pencil challenge set.

The fixed mixed challenge and its pre-registered reproductions show selected positives reproduce while hard cases expose a concrete boundary; the budget fix removes one failure mode on that fixed challenge.

Broad active maintenance, statistical robustness, ObjectNav/SPL, manipulation benchmark performance, passive-vs-active superiority, persistent writeback, cross-platform transfer, or a learned/general uncertainty model.

remaining_gaps: No broad scene, seed, object, or platform diversity claim.
No live OpenObject or natural downstream failure-row claim as a general result.
No verified Habitat perception-backed verify/update/task run yet.
recommended_next_paths: Write the paper around the fixed-challenge mechanism claim plus explicit limitations.
If broad scale is desired, pre-register a larger case-generation universe before any new run.
If platform breadth is desired, move to the Habitat verify/update smoke as a separate Stage 2 line.
